purpose: Prospective full-data check of the validated original training function with recoverable selected weights on current data; separate descriptive cohort
stop_rule: Complete all six jobs to original validation early-stop/max200; pause on integrity failure. No stopping or adding seeds based on test scores.
statistics: Per-seed macro-F1/accuracy, mean and sample SD; paired bank-minus-Doppler differences and t-based confidence interval, explicitly low precision at n=3. No equivalence claim, no newly chosen TOST margin.
reuse: Reuse R2 completed controls as separate-protocol results; deduplicate overlapping seeds. Partial 374-run campaign exploratory only.
not_claimed: Causal estimate of loop effect versus historic Blackwell R2
